[Python closed value-index checked records](checked-record-value-index-python-promotion-20261020.md)
record four hosted wheel selections on CPython 3.11 and 3.12 for top-level
copied checked-record parameter/result sites with closed Bool, String, and Nat
indices.

edits.previous: The compiler and reviewed contract admit three canonical index kinds: an unbounded `Nat`, `Bool`, and `String`. They are serialized as unsigned decimal, `true`/`false`, and exact Unicode-scalar text respectively; zero, the empty string, and supplementary characters are valid. Lean reduces a closed expression before recording it, so `1 + 2` and `decide (1 < 2)` become `3` and `true`. Open or opaque values are rejected. `Int`, `Char`, fixed-width or platform-width integers, `Fin`, functions, proofs, instances, and other index types require a separately reviewed representation and are not inferred from a host value. The [native-PHP](../evidence/checked-record-value-index-php-promotion-20261019.md) and [Perl](../evidence/checked-record-value-index-perl-promotion-20261020.md) value-index archives exercise all three closed forms at top-level copied checked-record parameter and result sites; the broader installed rollout remains separately tracked.
